page_title: Regex for macOS: Save Complete Regex Tests

sources.entry: Regex - Regular expression testing tool with an emphasis on simplicity.

summary.name: Regex 2.5
summary.one_liner: A macOS regular expression tester that saves the full test workspace (pattern, test data, replacement, capture group, and i/s/m options) locally on your Mac.
use_cases: saving and reopening regex test cases
duplicating a regex to try a variant
testing Swift Regex patterns on a Mac
checking capture groups and replacements before use
keeping regex experiments offline and local
summary.what_it_does: Regex 2.5 lets you save a complete regex test, including the pattern, test data, replacement text, selected capture group, and the i, s, and m matching options, so you can reopen it later in the same state. Opening a saved test creates a working copy; you can duplicate it to try a variant and keep the original, and a named test is changed only when you explicitly overwrite it. Saved tests are stored as JSON files under Application Support inside the app sandbox, with no account, cloud sync, or network service. The page states that Regex tests Swift Regex behavior, so the user should verify final patterns in grep, sed, nginx, an editor, or code before using them on important data.
notable: Saves the whole test workspace (pattern, test data, replacement, capture group, i/s/m options) and reopens it together
Open, Duplicate, and Overwrite workflow keeps the original test unchanged unless explicitly overwritten
Saved tests stay local in the app sandbox with no account, cloud sync, or analytics in the app
caveats: Tests Swift Regex behavior; other grep, sed, nginx, or editor flavors need separate verification
Listed at US$13.99 on the Mac App Store; the page does not describe a free tier
